title: beta-Sitosterol attenuates pulmonary arterial hypertension by activating the Nrf2-GPX4 axis to inhibit ferroptosis in pulmonary vascular cells.
authors: Xie, Yiming; Li, Jing; Liao, Juan; Meng, Hui; Lu, Chuanghong; Meng, Zhongyuan; Deng, Yan; Meng, Jianjun; Huang, Feng; Zeng, Zhiyu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究β-谷甾醇通过Nrf2-GPX4轴抑制肺动脉高压中的铁死亡，仅用分子对接初步提示BS与Nrf2直接作用，核心是细胞与动物实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) is a progressive vascular disorder in which oxidative stress and ferroptosis are key pathogenic drivers. Although beta-sitosterol (BS) shows therapeutic potential in PAH; however, its link to ferroptosis modulation remain poorly elucidated. This study evaluated the anti‑PAH efficacy of BS and its underlying mechanisms, focusing on the Nrf2-GPX4 axis, using a monocrotaline (MCT)‑induced rat model and hypoxia‑induced pulmonary arterial endothelial cells (PAECs) and smooth muscle cells (PASMCs). Inflammation responses, reactive oxygen species (ROS), and ferroptosis-related markers were assessed, along with molecular docking and pharmacological inhibition. In vivo, BS significantly ameliorated pulmonary vascular remodeling, improved right ventricular function, and mitigated oxidative stress by reducing ROS and MDA while restoring GSH levels, while up regulating the ferroptosis-protecive proteins xCT and GPX4. Molecular docking suggested direct interaction between BS and Nrf2. Notably, immunofluorescence revealed Nrf2 localization in both CD31(+) endothelial and alpha‑SMA(+) smooth muscle cells, with BS treatment substantially enhancing Nrf2 accumulation in both lineages. In vitro, BS promoted Nrf2 nuclear translocation in hypoxia-induced PAECs and PASMCs, correlating with suppressed oxidative and inflammatory responses and elevated xCT and GPX4 expression. Notably, the anti-oxidative and anti-ferroptotic effects of BS were abolished by the Nrf2 inhibitor ML385. These findings demonstrate that BS attenuates PAH via Nrf2‑GPX4‑driven ferroptosis inhibition in both in PAECs and PASMCs, uncovering a novel therapeutic target and new research directions regarding PAH pathogenesis and treatment.
abstract_zh: 肺动脉高压（PAH）是一种进行性血管疾病，其中氧化应激和铁死亡（ferroptosis）是关键致病驱动因素。尽管β-谷甾醇（beta-sitosterol, BS）在PAH中显示出治疗潜力，但其与铁死亡调控的关联仍未被充分阐明。本研究利用野百合碱（monocrotaline, MCT）诱导的大鼠模型以及低氧诱导的肺动脉内皮细胞（PAECs）和肺动脉平滑肌细胞（PASMCs），评估了BS的抗PAH疗效及其潜在机制，重点关注Nrf2-GPX4轴。检测了炎症反应、活性氧（ROS）和铁死亡相关标志物，并结合分子对接和药理学抑制实验。在体内，BS显著改善肺血管重塑，提高右心室功能，并通过降低ROS和MDA同时恢复GSH水平来缓解氧化应激，同时上调铁死亡保护蛋白xCT和GPX4。分子对接提示BS与Nrf2之间存在直接相互作用。值得注意的是，免疫荧光显示Nrf2定位于CD31(+)内皮细胞和alpha-SMA(+)平滑肌细胞中，BS处理显著增强了两种细胞谱系中Nrf2的积累。在体外，BS促进低氧诱导的PAECs和PASMCs中Nrf2核转位，这与氧化和炎症反应受抑以及xCT和GPX4表达升高相关。值得注意的是，BS的抗氧化和抗铁死亡效应被Nrf2抑制剂ML385所消除。这些发现表明，BS通过Nrf2-GPX4驱动的铁死亡抑制在PAECs和PASMCs中减轻PAH，揭示了关于PAH发病机制和治疗的新治疗靶点及新研究方向。
